sources: catalog/production/thomas-supplement-r1/brief-2026-11-19 (托马斯动作库补充-制作说明 item 8)

purpose.zh: 练大腿前侧和腹部抬腿的耐力，腿能扫得过去
purpose.en: Builds the hip and belly strength to lift and sweep your legs through.

text.zh: 挂在杠上肩往下沉，腿伸直抬到和地面平
text.en: Shoulders down on the bar, lift straight legs to level

text.zh: 抬到平停一下，再用三秒放下来，身体别晃。
text.en: Pause at level, take three seconds to lower, no swinging.
If you can't reach level yet, lift with bent knees.

commonErrors.en: Swinging back and forth for momentum.

cautions.zh: 手握不住就先做屈膝版，组数少一点
cautions.en: If your grip gives out, do the bent-knee version and fewer sets.

thomasSupplement.thomasAngle: 9 后侧支撑 / 12 第一侧换腿
thomasSupplement.note: defaultDose takes the low end of the brief range; the range is in doseBrief.
